# Stat tiles

A number with its label and an icon in a tone - and, as a button, the filter for what it counts: the numbers a person reads are the buttons they press.

## Examples

`stat` holds an [icon tile](icon-tile.md), a `stat-value` and a `stat-label`; `stat-primary`, `stat-success`, `stat-warning`, `stat-danger`, `stat-info` and `stat-secondary` - a quiet zero - tint the icon and the number. As a `button` with `aria-pressed` a tile is a toggle: pressed, it wears its tone's border and the list below shows only what it counts. A row is a grid: two tiles a row on a phone, four from `md:`.

```html
<div class="grid cols-2 md:cols-4 gap-12" role="group" aria-label="Show agents">
	<button class="stat" type="button" aria-pressed="true"><span class="icon-tile"><i class="bi bi-cpu" aria-hidden="true"></i></span><span><span class="stat-value">24</span><span class="stat-label">All agents</span></span></button>
	<button class="stat stat-primary" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><span class="icon-tile"><i class="bi bi-play-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i></span><span><span class="stat-value">3</span><span class="stat-label">Running</span></span></button>
	<button class="stat stat-warning" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><span class="icon-tile"><i class="bi bi-clock-history" aria-hidden="true"></i></span><span><span class="stat-value">2</span><span class="stat-label">Late</span></span></button>
	<button class="stat stat-secondary" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><span class="icon-tile"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon" aria-hidden="true"></i></span><span><span class="stat-value">0</span><span class="stat-label">Failed</span></span></button>
</div>
```

Without a button it only reads: a `div class="stat"`.

## Accessibility

- A tile button's name is its number and its label, "2 Late"; `aria-pressed` says it filters. Put the row in a `group` with a name.
- The tone repeats the label; it never says alone what the tile counts.
- Pressed, the tile also draws an outline in forced colors.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/stat.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/stat.css). It declares `--redz-stat-tone`, `--redz-tile-bg`, `--redz-tile-fg` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-text`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-fs-24`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-success`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-info`.
